Changes since `v1.1.24`.
### Improved
- **Checkbox staging in File Status** — Each file's checkbox now stages or unstages it directly, replacing the separate selection checkbox and the `+`/`−` row buttons. A folder's checkbox in Tree mode stages or unstages all its files, and the **Changed** and **Staged** header checkboxes stage or unstage everything. **Stage selected** and **Unstage selected** appear in the section header when you `Cmd`- or `Shift`-click two or more files.
[Compare v1.1.24 to v1.1.25](https://github.com/Commit-Plus/commit-plus/compare/v1.1.24...v1.1.25)
